module: Flowgraph node "Activity Attempt Vehicle" (category once_instant, tag activity). Adds a vehicle's information (jbeam model, partConfig configuration, isConfigFile if .pc) to an attempt under the key given by "vehKey" ("vehicle" by default). Inputs: vehKey (string), vehId (number, otherwise player vehicle 0), attempt (attemptData). Output: attempt. In career, adds originId/originKey (player's inventory or vehicle provided by the setup module).
notes: If no vehicle is found, the attempt output pin is not updated.
In career, the code reads self.mgr.activity.setupModules without a check: crashes without an associated activity.

workOnce.desc: Looks up the vehicle (vehId or player), builds {model, config, isConfigFile, originId, originKey} and writes it into attempt[vehKey].
